mapper.insert: INSERT INTO followup_task (patient_id, doctor_id, title, description, task_type, due_date, status, create_time) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{taskType}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM followup_task WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, u.user_name AS patient_name, d.name AS doctor_name FROM followup_task t LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = t.patient_id LEFT JOIN hospital_doctor d ON d.id = t.doctor_id WHERE t.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
